title: How a Blacklisted Chinese Tech Giant Kept Buying America’s Best A.I. Chips
summary: Washington imposed sanctions on Inspur because of its work with the Chinese military. But the company’s subsidiary kept shipping Nvidia’s best chips to feed China’s leading A.I. firms.
